opening.argument: MTI is presented as an automated Bitcoin investment opportunity: participants deposit Bitcoin into an account that copies the trades of MTI’s master traders. The offer describes “daily trading profits” measured in Bitcoin and supports the solicitation with claims of near-immediate withdrawals and possible future trading profits. It also promises profit allocations and referral or team-based bonuses, including “20% of that profit” directed into bonuses within a binary structure involving the participant and their team. The records do not verify the trading results, withdrawals, or bonus payments, but the combination of automated trading, proposed returns, and recruitment-linked rewards establishes the nature of the offer.

citations.quote: Where your account will copy the trades of the master traders of MTI.
The daily trading profits are percentages of Bitcoin.
20% of that profit goes to the profit sharing bonuses within the binary structure of the organization of which you and your team are part.
